description: Grid-rendered twin of matrixgame_covered_comm_3p: identical boards, ownership and protocols, but the board is sent as the ASCII grid (letters, X for teammates' objects, ## walls, . empty cells) instead of the compact inventory listing. 3 players, each owning 2 of 6 objects.
